position: Small reviewed registry before corpus scale
headline: VedaPath now has one visible source inventory instead of source records hidden inside application code.
copy: The registry is metadata and reviewed summaries only; it does not publish licensed translations.

postures.title: Registry file
postures.copy: Nine deterministic records include citation, family, status, keywords, and boundary.

postures.title: GET /sources
postures.copy: Lists source metadata with optional family and status filters.

postures.title: GET /search
postures.copy: Returns ranked candidates and match reasons without composing answers.

postures.title: No-source guard
postures.copy: Unsupported modern and medical overclaims remain blocked.

postures.title: Full text
postures.copy: The registry does not distribute licensed translation text.

flow.title: Rank
flow.copy: Score exact phrases, keywords, titles, citations, and family terms.

flow.title: Return
flow.copy: Expose candidates or a transparent no-source result.

decisions.label: Registry size
decisions.reason: A small fixture set keeps review quality visible.

decisions.label: Families
decisions.reason: Bhagavad Gita, Veda, and Upanishad records stay categorized.

decisions.label: Expansion
decisions.reason: New records require boundary and reviewer status.

locks.title: Live AI lock
locks.copy: No live model call is enabled.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: No durable user, reviewer, telemetry, or account storage is created.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: No licensed translation or corpus delivery is assumed.

locks.title: Authority lock
locks.copy: VedaPath remains source-backed study and reflection support, not a guru or clinician.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Private demo readiness does not authorize public launch.

packet:
Curated Source Registry v4.7.9
Records: 9 deterministic citation records including the no-source guard.
Endpoints: GET /sources and GET /search.
Boundary: citation metadata and reviewed summaries only.
